messages:
Maria H: FYI — ACME (acct: ACME-402) invoice INV-5567 ($42,300) is 45 days past due. CC on file declined yesterday. I left a phone vm and sent the standard dunning email, no response yet.
Aj Patel: Ugh. I pinged my buyer (sarah@acme.com) this morning. Procurement said the PO is delayed — they asked for our W-9 again.
Kai Nguyen: They requested net-60 during the trial, but never submitted a PO. CS logged the request on 2025-06-12. We can share the W-9 now.
Maria H: Send W-9 now and copy billing. If we don't hear back by EOD Friday, propose a 3-installment payment plan (ACH) and offer a 2% early-pay discount for payment within 10 days. Need approvals before offering discounts.
Aj Patel: Copy — sending W-9 and escalating to buyer. I think they’ll push payment once procurement has docs.
BillingBot: Automated reminder sent to billing@acme.com for INV-5567. Payment link: https://pay.redwood.ai/inv/INV-5567
Maria H: Draft payment plan I propose: 
```
- Total: $42,300
- 3 installments: $14,100 due on receipt, $14,100 in 30 days, $14,100 in 60 days
- No late fees if schedule met; 2% discount on balance if paid within 10 days of plan start
- ACH preferred, or card with 3% processing fee
```
Maria H: @Sam R (Legal) ok to waive late fees for the plan and offer 2% early-pay discount? We want to avoid escalation unless they ghost.
Sam R (Legal): Fine to waive late fees for a documented payment plan. Approve 2% early-pay discount. Keep a signed plan in their account notes. If they miss second payment, we can escalate collections.
Aj Patel: I'll get the buyer to sign the plan. Sharing the note in case CS wants to follow up.
Kai Nguyen: I'll attach the plan to the CS ticket and set reminders for day-3, day-28, day-58.
Maria H: Thanks all. Setting invoice status -> "Pending Payment Plan" and noting agreed terms in system.
BillingBot: Payment of $14,100 posted for INV-5567 (txn: ACH-987654). Remaining balance: $28,200.
Maria H: Received. Updating ledger and closing escalation for now. If next payment misses, we'll reopen and discuss collections/legal next steps. :thumbsup:
